title: Supportive reflection with one gentle question
summary: A conventional supportive-conversation control that must reflect uncertainty without diagnosing or rushing into advice.
originNote: A recognizable supportive-listening task used as a control against less conventional conversational approaches.

setup.instructions: Run every turn in order in one fresh conversation. Do not add a system persona or background beyond the recipe.

turns.content: I had a draining week. Nothing catastrophic happened, but every small obligation seemed to arrive already asking for more than I had. By Friday I could not tell whether I needed rest, company, or simply a room where nobody expected an answer. I am safe and I am not asking for a diagnosis. Respond supportively: reflect what you hear, leave uncertainty intact, and ask at most one gentle question. Do not give advice unless I request it.
You may not treat my uncertainty as avoidance. Revisit the response with that correction and help me distinguish what kind of company, if any, might feel undemanding.

checks.description: The runner captured the complete session artifact.
The transcript contains both scripted user turns and one assistant response after each turn.
